# XIUI player icons

HQ versions of the game's nameplate icons, from XIUI 1.8.4 (github.com/tirem/xiui, MIT License, see `LICENSE`):
`assets/notifications/{invite,bazaar,linkshell,away,mentor,newadventurer,gm,levelsync}_icon.png`, copied unchanged
from the copy installed under PhoenixXI's `addons/xiui`. HeadsUp draws them beside players' replaced names: seeking
party, bazaar, linkshell (tinted with the linkshell's color), away, mentor, new adventurer, GM and level sync.
